facts.business: The company manufactures thermal insulation jackets and nodulated wool for the friction industry, providing thermal insulation solutions to various industries with a focus on energy saving and reducing carbon emissions.

segments.name: Manufacturer and Contractor of Insulation Products and Prefabricated Thermal Insulation Jackets

capacity_or_capex.item: Purchase of additional plant and machinery funded via IPO proceeds
capacity_or_capex.timeline: IPO in 2025; funds kept in fixed deposit and to be utilized as and when machinery is purchased

guidance_or_targets.statement: With the Indian economy set to grow at the rate of more than 5%, there is an indication of Industrial growth and as such the company's future path appears very encouraging.
